items.title: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen
items.title_zh: Astra声称可读取并编辑Qwen模型权重
items.title_en: Astra Claims It Can Read and Edit Qwen Weights
items.summary: A blog post claims Astra can inspect and directly edit the weights of small networks, including hand-tuning a small Qwen model to roughly 5x its math performance, sparking intense debate about whether this is emergent weight comprehension or a product of targeted training data.

items.title: 树莓派5正式发布  4GB 型号的售价为 60 美元，8GB 版本的售价为 80 美元（另加当地税费  - 2.4GHz四核64位Arm Cortex-A76
items.title_zh: 树莓派5发布：2.4GHz Cortex-A76 与双4K60 HDMI，售价60美元起
items.title_en: Raspberry Pi 5 launches with 2.4GHz Cortex-A76 and dual 4K60 HDMI, from $60
items.summary: The Raspberry Pi 5 was officially launched with a 2.4GHz quad-core Arm Cortex-A76 CPU, VideoCore VII GPU, dual 4K60 HDMI, and pricing at $60 for 4GB and $80 for 8GB.

items.title: vllm-project/vllm released v0.33.0rc3
items.title_zh: vLLM v0.33.0rc3 发布：升级 PyTorch 2.14、仅提供 CUDA 13.0 wheel，并新增大量模型支持
items.title_en: vLLM v0.33.0rc3: PyTorch 2.14, CUDA 13.0-only wheels, and a wave of new models
items.summary: vLLM v0.33.0rc3 brings numerous new model support additions, a PyTorch 2.14 upgrade, CUDA 13.0-only release artifacts, and an ABI-stable libtorch CUDA wheel.

items.title: 🤖 ChatGPT 分享链接漏洞可致账号被接管
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 分享链接漏洞可致账号被接管，现已修复
items.title_en: ChatGPT share-link flaw allowed account takeover, now patched
items.summary: Parameter researchers found a ChatGPT share-link vulnerability that could execute code in a logged-in user's session and exfiltrate private conversations, which OpenAI fixed as a P1 issue.

items.title: 提醒：有服务器的记得更新内核，Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 存在高危释放后使用漏洞（CVE-2026-98432）
items.title_zh: Linux 内核 IPv4 TCP 高危释放后使用漏洞（CVE-2026-98432）可远程 RCE
items.title_en: Critical Linux kernel IPv4 TCP use-after-free (CVE-2026-98432) enables remote RCE
items.summary: A Telegram alert warns of a critical unauthenticated network-exploitable use-after-free in the Linux kernel's IPv4 TCP stack (CVE-2026-98432), with a published RCE PoC and default exposure for Go 1.24+ services via MPTCP.
